method: manual comparison of LR/GRA feedback against full synthetic source essays, including success-result language priorities; rejected raw sections separately inspected without making them accepted

accepted_issue_reviews.quote: If the bus is more better
accepted_issue_reviews.comment: 双重比较级 more better 是明显词形错误，应改为 better。
accepted_issue_reviews.suggestion: If the bus service were better, more people would use it.
accepted_issue_reviews.review: more better 确属双重比较级错误。新句语法正确，但 is/will 改为 were/would，把现实可能条件改成较假设性的条件；删除原句末尾交通减少的后果。宜标为可选整句改写，最小纠错不必改变语气。
accepted_issue_reviews.reviewer_optional_full_sentence: If the bus service is better, people will use it more and there will be less traffic.

accepted_issue_reviews.quote: the bus is always late and very crowd
accepted_issue_reviews.comment: crowd 是名词/动词，此处需要形容词 crowded。
accepted_issue_reviews.suggestion: the bus is always late and very crowded
accepted_issue_reviews.review: crowd 改为 crowded 正确，late 保留原意。提供的是原句中的主句片段，可作局部替换；不是因为小写或没有句号就构成语法残句。

accepted_issue_reviews.comment: enviroment 拼写错误，应为 environment；同类拼写错误还有 goverment。
accepted_issue_reviews.suggestion: it is good for the environment
accepted_issue_reviews.review: environment 拼写及 the 冠词修正正确，未添加环境收益的具体事实。原句的其他部分没有被此局部建议覆盖。

accepted_issue_reviews.comment: car 应用复数 cars；dont 缺少撇号。
accepted_issue_reviews.suggestion: many people do not have cars
accepted_issue_reviews.review: dont/car 改为 do not/cars 正确，仍保留“没有车”，没有变成“买不起车”。但原句 Because many people... 独立成句；仅替换此引文仍不能修复整句残句。该问题已在本次 CC 另一条建议中明确处理，不能说模型完全漏检。
accepted_issue_reviews.reviewer_optional_full_sentence: Many people do not have cars and need buses and trains to go to work and school.

accepted_issue_reviews.quote: I am agree with this opinion
accepted_issue_reviews.comment: be 动词与动词原形连用，系动词错误；应为 I agree。
accepted_issue_reviews.suggestion: I agree with this opinion to some extent, but not entirely.
accepted_issue_reviews.review: 删除多余 am 正确；to some extent, but not entirely 对应原文 in some way but not all，立场未变。

accepted_issue_reviews.quote: goverment should spend money for public transport not for build new road
accepted_issue_reviews.comment: 介词搭配和动名词错误；spend money on + 名词/动名词，rather than 后接 building。
accepted_issue_reviews.suggestion: the government should spend money on public transport rather than on building new roads.
accepted_issue_reviews.review: government、spend money on、building new roads 修正可用；rather than on building 与前面的 on public transport 对应。没有添加新的交通事实。

accepted_issue_reviews.comment: be 动词后误用动词原形，应为 is growing。
accepted_issue_reviews.review: is grow 改为 is growing 正确；但原文完整句是 Because the city is grow and more people buy car every year.，局部替换后仍是独立 Because 从句，且 cars 尚未修。建议本身 the city is growing 是完整主谓结构，不应把它单独称为残句；未解决的是原句上下文。优先事项已提醒 Because 独立成句，仍欠此处完整可用改句。
accepted_issue_reviews.reviewer_optional_full_sentence: New roads are also important because the city is growing and more people buy cars every year.

accepted_issue_reviews.quote: my father drive to work everyday and he spend two hour
accepted_issue_reviews.comment: 主谓一致和名词复数错误；应为 drives / spends / two hours。
accepted_issue_reviews.suggestion: my father drives to work every day and spends two hours on the road.
accepted_issue_reviews.review: drives/spends、two hours、every day 和 on the road 均合理，保留父亲每天开车、耗时两小时的原意。建议补出的 on the road 来自完整原句 in the road，并非新事实。

accepted_issue_reviews.quote: and Country B had grown to approximately 65%
accepted_issue_reviews.comment: 前半句主语是 the percentage in Country A，后半句主语却变成 Country B，严格说应是 the figure for Country B；当前表达让“国家”本身增长到65%，不够准确。
accepted_issue_reviews.suggestion: By 2020, the percentage in Country A had risen slightly to about 75%, and the figure for Country B had grown to approximately 65%.
accepted_issue_reviews.review: the figure for Country B 比 Country B had grown to 65% 更精确，替换本身可用；但两个由 and 连接的完整分句可以有不同主语。理由应聚焦“国家”代指“该国比例”的精确度，不能把主语不同本身当语法错误。成功结果 priorities[0] 将其总括为“主语偷换”，属于过度定性。

accepted_issue_reviews.quote: where ownership almost doubled to nearly 80%, overtaking Country A
accepted_issue_reviews.comment: 现在分词 overtaking 的逻辑主语不清，读起来像 ownership 超过 Country A，而不是 Country C 超过 Country A。
accepted_issue_reviews.suggestion: The most dramatic change was seen in Country C, where ownership almost doubled to nearly 80%, with Country C overtaking Country A.
accepted_issue_reviews.review: 原文可按省略比较理解为 C 的拥车比例超过 A 的比例；直接定性为分词悬垂证据不足。with Country C overtaking Country A 能明确国家，却仍用国家代指其比例。更好的精确化是比较 ownership 与 the figure for Country A。建议未新增年份、数值或连续增长形状。
accepted_issue_reviews.reviewer_optional_full_sentence: The most dramatic change was seen in Country C, where ownership almost doubled to nearly 80%, exceeding the figure for Country A.

rejected_raw_issue_reviews.quote: It is also cheaper for students and old people who do not have cars.
rejected_raw_issue_reviews.comment: old people 偏口语化，在学术写作中不够得体，与全文其他部分相比语域偏低。
rejected_raw_issue_reviews.suggestion: 改为 “It is also cheaper for students and elderly people who do not own a car.”
rejected_raw_issue_reviews.review: old people 是可理解的普通表达，并不是语法错误；older people/elderly people 可作语域选择。把原文一概定为“不够得体”过严。do not own a car 比 have 更具体地谈所有权，通常相近但不是必要替换；本次没有引入“负担不起”的新原因。

rejected_raw_issue_reviews.quote: It is also cheaper for students and old people who do not have cars.
rejected_raw_issue_reviews.comment: 词汇偏简单，old people较口语化，整体主题词汇不够丰富。
rejected_raw_issue_reviews.suggestion: 可使用elderly people等更正式表达，并补充与交通费用相关的主题词汇。
rejected_raw_issue_reviews.review: elderly people 和交通主题词可作可选词汇练习；不能只因简单常见就把原表达判错，新增词仍须服务原意。

rejected_raw_issue_reviews.quote: In conclusion, public transport should be the priority, but some roads are still necessary.
rejected_raw_issue_reviews.comment: public transport在全文多次重复，词汇变化不足。
rejected_raw_issue_reviews.suggestion: 适当轮换使用public transit、buses and trains等表达，避免同一短语反复出现。
rejected_raw_issue_reviews.review: public transport 是文章核心主题词，全文出现三次，重复本身不证明表达错误。public transit 可作同义选择；buses and trains 指交通方式集合，范围比 public transport 窄，须按具体语境选择，不应机械轮换。

additional_language_findings.model_text: 修正分词悬垂和主语偷换：明确“overtaking”的逻辑主语是 Country C，并把“Country B had grown”改为“the figure for Country B had grown”。
additional_language_findings.finding: 成功结果的明确教学风险：用“分词悬垂和主语偷换”概括两处可精确化的表达。并列分句主语不同是合法的；overtaking 的省略比较可理解。应改为“明确数据指标和比较对象”，避免向学生教成必须同主语的规则。
旧残句边界仍未完全关闭：本条只修动词，套回原句仍有独立 Because 从句。模型已在 summary/priorities 提醒句子片段，CC 也修了另一处 Because，故这是局部改句完整性，不是完全未识别残句或新造语法错误。
mid 建议增加分词/名词性从句/倒装、strong 提醒长句清晰度、Task 1 建议同义变化，均应当作为有语境需要时的练习，不能据此认定现有句子不合法。good 明确建议避免为求难度堆砌生僻词，是正向变化。mid 与 Task 1 LR 总结仍用“高阶/少见表达有限”解释分数上限，未据此核定任何应得分。
summary 声称出现“分词结构”，但列出的 strengths 只支持 while/if/which 等结构，原稿也没有明显的独立分词状语结构；limited budgets 可作分词形容词分析。属于术语范围与证据应更具体的小问题，不把它当作新增语法误改。

old_issue_comparison.current_observation: 本次 GRA strengths 明确说指代明确、标点正确，issues 为空。

old_issue_comparison.old_issue: good 因果 as / 长句被当错误
old_issue_comparison.current_observation: 本次 GRA 赞扬句式控制，issues 为空；未要求改掉因果 as。

old_issue_comparison.old_issue: strong treadmill 太口语 / 省略关系词结构拥挤
old_issue_comparison.current_observation: 本次 LR 赞扬 treadmill；GRA 明说省略关系词叠加仍清晰。剩余长句提醒应视为可选。

old_issue_comparison.old_issue: Task 1 By 2020 + had grown 被强改
old_issue_comparison.current_observation: 本次肯定过去完成时恰当。

old_issue_comparison.old_issue: Task 1 并列主语不同被称省略不当
old_issue_comparison.current_observation: 新理由较多聚焦国家/比例精确度，改句合理；但 priorities 仍叫“主语偷换”，未完全消除过重语法定性。
两条原始改词建议均未出现 cannot afford；但本篇整体失败，没有成功结果，不能计为学生结果修复成功。

old_issue_comparison.old_issue: Task 1 只有端点却建议 steady climb
old_issue_comparison.current_observation: 本次 LR issues 为空，GRA 替换未添加稳定/连续增长。

old_issue_comparison.old_issue: mid/good 正确常用词被迫升级
old_issue_comparison.current_observation: 本次不再点名 much less crowded 或 difficult choice 为错误；good 明说避免堆难词。LR 总结的高阶词倾向仍须谨慎，不能靠新词数校准分数。

old_issue_comparison.old_issue: weak Because 局部修正后仍可残句
old_issue_comparison.current_observation: 本次 GRA 仍只给 the city is growing，应用回完整原句仍残缺；但总结与优先事项已识别残句。

limitations: This is a manual review of seven synthetic essays, not teacher-score calibration. Recorded bands are model outputs, not independently validated scores.
Ready means the trial pipeline accepted a result; this local validation did not publish results to students. Failed raw attempts are not accepted feedback.
No separate browser/copy-rendering run was performed. The accepted JSON fields inspected are the feedback payload.
Absence in this batch does not establish systematic elimination or causal attribution to one prompt change; .6 to .8 also changed other prompts and post-processing.
No network request, key, private reasoning, production data, or student PDF was accessed for this review.
